_vocabulary_mapping.resolver: vr_condition_audit.inventory.resolve_category (canonical id or alias match; returns None when the name is not in the vocabulary)
_vocabulary_mapping.placement_rule: place_furniture places an object only when its category resolves AND the resolved element's layer is ffe or fixture; anything else is dropped by a bare continue and does NOT appear in the room's _skipped list

objects.skipped_reason: no prior: round_table is neither an id nor an alias in the inventory. Nearest unused candidates, NOT applied here because substituting a category would change what the evaluation is testing: coffee_table (alias low_table) and dining_table (aliases table, meeting_table).

no prior: divider is neither an id nor an alias. The inventory element matching the photograph's wood-slat partition is slat_divider (aliases timber_slat_wall, slat_wall, batten_screen, feature_wall), but slat_divider sits on the STRUCTURAL layer, which place_furniture excludes by design. So this object cannot be placed as furniture under any spelling. Category left unchanged so the run shows the pipeline's real behaviour.
